subject: When trying to install Rattle, I keep getting the message: "package 'rattle' is not available (for R version 3.1.1)".

messages.author: b9d615a3b2b6cc0b
messages.subject: When trying to install Rattle, I keep getting the message: "package 'rattle' is not available (for R version 3.1.1)".
parts:
For instance, in response to the input
> install.packages("rattle", repos="http://rattle.togaware.com", type="source")
 I get the messages:
Warning: unable to access index for repository http://rattle.togaware.com/src/contrib
Warning message:
package ‘rattle’ is not available (for R version 3.1.1)
>
I get the same messages from other CRAN sites. Please help!

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: When trying to install Rattle, I keep getting the message: "package 'rattle' is not available (for R version 3.1.1)".
parts:

I wonder if this might be a firewall problem?

Can you install other packages?

Are you able to visit http://rattle.togaware.com/src/contrib ?
